title: Track your order
body_html:
Once your order ships, we email a tracking number.

Open the shipping confirmation email or go to Account > Orders and select the order to see live tracking. Tracking can take up to 24 hours to update after the label is created.

title: Shipping times and delivery estimates
body_html:
Standard shipping within Canada takes 3 to 7 business days.

Express shipping takes 1 to 3 business days. Orders placed before 2pm ET on a business day are processed the same day. Delivery estimates are shown at checkout.

title: International shipping
body_html:
We ship to the United States and 40 other countries.

International orders take 7 to 15 business days. Customs duties and import taxes are charged by the destination country and are paid by the customer on delivery.

title: Change your shipping address
body_html:
You can change the shipping address within 1 hour of placing an order from Account > Orders > Edit address.

After the order is packed, the address can no longer be changed, but you can ask the carrier to redirect the package.

title: Cancel an order
body_html:
Orders can be cancelled within 1 hour of purchase from Account > Orders > Cancel order.

Once an order has shipped it cannot be cancelled, but you can return it after delivery for a refund.

title: Return an item
body_html:
Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging.

Start a return from Account > Orders > Return item to print a free return label. Final-sale items cannot be returned.

title: Refund timing
body_html:
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days after we receive and inspect your return.

Your bank may take another 3 to 5 days to show the refund on your statement.

title: Exchange for a different size or colour
body_html:
To exchange an item for a different size or colour, start a return and choose Exchange.

We ship the replacement as soon as the original is scanned by the carrier. Exchanges are free within Canada.

title: Damaged or defective item
body_html:
If an item arrives damaged or defective, contact us within 14 days with a photo of the item and the packaging.

We will send a free replacement or issue a full refund, and you do not need to return the damaged item.

title: Package marked delivered but missing
body_html:
If tracking shows delivered but you cannot find the package, check with neighbours and your building mailroom, and wait 24 hours because carriers sometimes mark packages early.

If it is still missing, contact us and we will open a carrier investigation.

title: Accepted payment methods
body_html:
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and store gift cards.

All payments are processed securely and we never store your full card number.

title: Payment declined at checkout
body_html:
A declined payment is usually caused by an incorrect billing address, postal code or CVV, or a limit set by your bank.

Double-check your card details, try another payment method, or contact your bank to approve the transaction.

title: Discount and promo codes
body_html:
Enter a discount code in the Discount code box at checkout and select Apply.

Only one code can be used per order. Codes cannot be applied to gift cards or to orders that have already been placed.

title: Gift cards
body_html:
Digital gift cards are delivered by email and never expire.

Check your gift card balance at checkout by entering the code. Gift cards cannot be exchanged for cash or used to buy other gift cards.

title: Reset your password
body_html:
Select Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter your email address.

We will send a reset link that is valid for 30 minutes. Check your spam folder if the email does not arrive within a few minutes.

title: Update your account details
body_html:
Update your name, email address, phone number or saved addresses from Account > Profile.

Changes to your email address require confirmation from both your old and new inbox.

title: Manage a subscription
body_html:
Pause, skip, or cancel a subscription delivery from Account > Subscriptions.

Changes must be made at least 3 days before the next renewal date to take effect for that delivery.

title: Price adjustments after a sale
body_html:
If an item you bought drops in price within 7 days of purchase, contact us with your order number and we will refund the difference to your original payment method.

Price adjustments do not apply to clearance items.

title: Size guide
body_html:
Each product page has a size chart with measurements in centimetres and inches.

If you are between sizes, we recommend sizing up. Customer reviews often mention whether an item runs small or large.

title: Contact us and support hours
body_html:
Our support team is available by live chat and email from 9am to 9pm ET, seven days a week.

Email replies are sent within 24 hours.
